rooms.name: entrance hall
rooms.description: You are standing in the entrance hall of an obsidian tower. The walls here are of dull black stone, while the floor is of black marble run through with swirls of silver. A black marble archway exits the room to the north into the forest, and another exits to the south deeper into the tower.
